submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.1026% at Sb=0.411 (index 12). Index 13 (Sb=0.448) gave nearly the same, 0.1009%, so the peak sits around Sb≈0.41–0.45. EQE drops off on both sides: 0.020% at Sb 0.216, about 0 at 0.675 and 0.054% at 0.816. XRD at Sb 0.35, 0.41 and 0.52 showed identical peak sets, so there is one phase across this range and XRD cannot tell these compositions apart.

rejected.reason: EQE about 0 at Sb 0.675, near NiSb2O6 stoichiometry
